title: Investigating Microsoft 365 Activities: Audit, Content Search and Graph Activity Logs

header.html: Investigate threats by using Microsoft Purview Audit; investigate threats by using Content search in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery; investigate threats by using Microsoft Graph activity logs
the official Microsoft SC-200 study guide (skills measured as of October 21, 2026) and Microsoft Learn

toc.title: Content search in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery

html:
1Three sources, three questions

Source Question it answers
Microsoft Purview Audit Who did what, and when? (sign-ins, file access, mailbox activity, admin changes)
Content search (Purview eDiscovery) Where is this message or file? Find, preview, export and purge content
Microsoft Graph activity logs Which app or user called the Graph API, and what did it request?

2Microsoft Purview Audit

Audit (Standard) and Audit (Premium) are both enabled by default.

Item Standard Premium
Default retention 180 days One year for Entra, Exchange, OneDrive, SharePoint; 180 days for other workloads
Longer retention None Policies up to one year, or 10 years with the per-user 10-Year Audit Log Retention add-on (not retroactive)
Extra events Core events MailItemsAccessed, Send, SearchQueryInitiatedExchange and intelligent insights
Search export 50,000 rows 1,000,000 rows

Non-user records (service principals, system events) are kept one year and cannot be changed.

Search fact Detail
Path Purview portal > Audit > Search
Defaults Last seven days (UTC); maximum range 180 days
Filters Admin units, activities, record types, users, file/folder/site, workloads
Keyword search Only the indexed common-schema fields, not the whole AuditData blob
Limits 10 parallel search jobs per user; one unfiltered job; completed jobs kept 30 days
Latency Core services 60 to 90 minutes
Role Can do
Audit Manager (role group) Search, export, and turn auditing on or off
Audit Reader Search and export only
Audit Logs / View-Only Audit Logs The underlying roles

PowerShell (Exchange Online): Get-AdminAuditLogConfig shows the setting UnifiedAuditLogIngestionEnabled; Set-AdminAuditLogConfig -UnifiedAuditLogIngestionEnabled $true enables it; Search-UnifiedAuditLog searches. SearchQueryInitiatedExchange must be enabled per mailbox with Set-Mailbox and the AuditOwner setting.

Exam tip

. Standard = 180 days. Premium = one year by default, up to 10 years with the add-on. Audit Reader can search; Audit Manager can also change settings.

3Content search in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery

The classic eDiscovery and Content search tools retired on August 31, 2025. The content search capability continues in the new Microsoft Purview eDiscovery experience [Verify live: menus differ, concepts are the same].

Step Detail
Create Name, Locations (Exchange mailboxes, SharePoint sites, public folders), Conditions, Submit
Keyword query Operators AND, OR, NOT, NEAR; a keyword list can have up to 20 rows
Review Statistics (match counts per keyword), preview, export
Role eDiscovery Manager (Compliance Search to search)

4Search and purge

Use it to remove a malicious message from mailboxes. Commands run in Security & Compliance PowerShell.

Step Command
Search New-ComplianceSearch then Start-ComplianceSearch
Purge New-ComplianceSearchAction -SearchName "name" -Purge -PurgeType SoftDelete or HardDelete
Check Get-ComplianceSearchAction (the action is named name_Purge)
Fact Detail
SoftDelete Moves to Recoverable Items\Deletions; the user can recover it
HardDelete Moves to the Purges folder; removed permanently
Limits 10 items per mailbox per purge; 50,000 mailboxes per search; not for mailboxes on litigation or in-place hold
Not deleted Teams chat, SharePoint and OneDrive content, unindexed items
Roles Compliance Search or eDiscovery Manager to search; Search And Purge to purge
Missing role Error "A parameter cannot be found that matches parameter name 'Purge'"

With Defender for Office 365 Plan 2, use Threat Explorer remediation instead (Module 11).

Exam tip

. The "Purge parameter not found" error means the Search And Purge role is missing. Teams chat and SharePoint files are not purged by this method.

5Microsoft Graph activity logs

Graph activity logs record every request to the Microsoft Graph API for your tenant. Table: MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs.

Fact Detail
License Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2
Enable Diagnostic settings for the Microsoft Graph activity logs category; role Security Administrator
Destinations Log Analytics workspace, storage account, event hub
Filtering Cannot be filtered in diagnostic settings; use workspace transformations or the Basic plan to cut cost
Latency Usually 30 minutes, up to 2 hours
Blind spot Multitenant apps in other tenants
Warning Secrets in request URIs are logged

Key columns: AppId, UserId, ServicePrincipalId, IPAddress, RequestUri, RequestMethod, ResponseStatusCode, ClientAuthMethod (0 public, 1 secret, 2 certificate), UniqueTokenId, SignInActivityId, Scopes, Roles.

Use it to detect abnormal call volume, new privileged app permissions, a compromised user's API activity, and to join with SigninLogs on SignInActivityId (equals UniqueTokenIdentifier).

Exam tip

. Graph activity logs have to be turned on; they are not on by default. Join to sign-in logs to find how a token was obtained.

6Exam Q&A

6.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1An analyst must find who deleted files from a SharePoint site 100 days ago. The organization has Audit (Standard). Where should the analyst search?

  • AMicrosoft Graph activity logs in a Log Analytics workspace
  • BThe Content search tool with a keyword and a purge action
  • CThe Defender for Endpoint device timeline of the file server
  • DThe Purview portal Audit search over the last 100 days
Show the answer

Answer: D. Audit search covers activities within the 180-day Standard retention.

S2Compliance requires keeping audit records of mailbox access for ten years for selected users. What is needed?

  • AAudit (Standard), because it keeps records for ten years
  • BAudit (Premium) with a policy and the 10-Year Audit Log Retention add-on
  • CA longer analytics retention in Sentinel for the table
  • DA Basic logs plan on the audit table in the workspace
Show the answer

Answer: B. Premium policies can keep records for 10 years with the per-user add-on; it is not retroactive.

S3A user needs to search and export audit logs but must not turn auditing on or off. Which role group fits?

  • AAudit Manager, which can also change the settings
  • BeDiscovery Manager, which can only purge messages
  • CSecurity Reader, which can only view the secure score
  • DAudit Reader, which can only search and export
Show the answer

Answer: D. Audit Reader can search and export; Audit Manager can also enable or disable auditing.

S4An analyst runs New-ComplianceSearchAction with -Purge and gets an error that the Purge parameter cannot be found. What is missing?

  • AAn eDiscovery hold on every searched mailbox
  • BAudit (Premium) licensing for the whole tenant
  • CA larger limit for items per mailbox purge
  • DThe Search And Purge role for the account
Show the answer

Answer: D. The Purge parameter appears only for accounts that hold the Search And Purge role.

S5A phishing message must be removed so that users can still recover it for a while. Which purge type should be used?

  • AHardDelete, which moves items to the Purges folder
  • BSoftDelete, which moves items to Recoverable Items\Deletions
  • CRelease, which moves items to the user's inbox again
  • DBlock, which adds the sender to a list of blocked senders and domains
Show the answer

Answer: B. SoftDelete keeps items in Recoverable Items\Deletions where they can be recovered.

S6A SOC suspects a stolen app token is being used to read mail through the Graph API. Which data source shows the requests?

  • AThe Syslog table filled by a Linux forwarder
  • BThe SecurityEvent table from domain controllers
  • CThe OfficeActivity table from the Office 365 connector
  • DThe MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs table from Entra diagnostic settings
Show the answer

Answer: D. Graph activity logs record the API requests with app, user, IP and URI, once diagnostic settings send them to a workspace.

6.2 Recall questions

R1What is the Audit (Standard) retention?

Show the answer

180 days.

R2What is the maximum audit search range?

Show the answer

180 days.

R3What is the purge limit per mailbox?

Show the answer

10 items per mailbox per purge.

R4Which license is needed for Graph activity logs?

Show the answer

Microsoft Entra ID P1 or P2.

R5Which cmdlet enables unified audit log ingestion?

Show the answer

Set-AdminAuditLogConfig -UnifiedAuditLogIngestionEnabled $true.

R6Which content is not purged by search and purge?

Show the answer

Teams chat, SharePoint and OneDrive content.

7Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Audit Standard 180 days; Premium one year, 10 years with add-on; Audit Manager vs Audit Reader
Search Purview > Audit > Search; 7 days default, 180 days maximum; Search-UnifiedAuditLog
Content search locations, conditions, keywords; eDiscovery Manager; classic tools retired Aug 31, 2025
Purge SoftDelete or HardDelete; Search And Purge; 10 items per mailbox
Graph activity logs MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs; diagnostic settings; Entra ID P1; Security Administrator
